name: Being Betrayed
overview: Scripture acknowledges the painful reality of betrayal, even from those closest to us, as Jesus warns that believers will be betrayed by family and friends, sometimes facing severe consequences including death. Despite such trials, believers are called to fear God rather than human adversaries, trusting in His ultimate authority over soul and body. The presence of sinful behaviors, described as works of the flesh, underscores the fallen nature that leads to betrayal. Yet, enduring these temptations faithfully brings the promise of the crown of life to those who love the Lord.
